FAQ

Can I call a real phone?

No. A call number rings another EcoMeet user who has the page open.

How many people can join?

Up to ten people per meeting. After that, the meeting shows as full.

Are accounts and credits stored on a server?

Not in this demo. Accounts, numbers and saved contacts live in your browser only.
